name: Splinter Cell: Deathwatch
s: In the shadowy world of espionage, Sam Fisher is a rumor and a legend. Pulled back into action, he must help a new recruit unravel a global conspiracy.

paragraphs.text: Splinter Cell: Deathwatch is an adult animated espionage action television series created by Derek Kolstad, based on the Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell video game franchise by Ubisoft. The series stars Liev Schreiber as the voice of Sam Fisher alongside Kirby as Zinnia McKenna. It is directed by Sun Creature Studio co-founder Guillaume Dousse and produced by Ubisoft Film & Television while animation services are provided by FOST Studio.
The series premiered on October 14, 2025, on Netflix. A day after the premiere, the series was renewed for a second season.

On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, the series holds an approval rating of 86%, based on 14 reviews. Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned a score of 70 out of 100, based on 4 critics, indicating "generally favorable" reviews.
